narrative.details: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
narrative.objectives: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
narrative.offerRewardText: Our tools!When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
narrative.requestItemsText: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
